race.comment: JUST PETTY CASH (7) has the clearest winning profile after consecutive placings, the latest a second at this track when heavily supported into very short odds-on territory and beaten just over a length by Black Irish. Winkers go on for the first time now and she looks ready to go one better. ALOT OF DESIRE (3) has upside after placing on debut at this track, with a bump at the start adding context to a third behind Beston Street. The 1413m doesn't look an issue and with a favourable set up, he can get the job done. DIVER DAN (2) brings a useful CL1 fourth two back and then a second here as a well-supported favourite. Out in trip now looks to hold the key and he can put it all together this time. ANDERSHINE (4) has been fourth at both starts, with awkward starts and traffic against him, and that gives him a genuine chance as he steps up in distance again. FORTGANG (10) finds a suitable race today and has claims with no weight on her back.
